messages:
maya: Quick sync — I dropped a tentative egress window for the new ap-southeast region on 2024-06-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. Partner maintenance shows 02:30-03:30 overlapping. Need to deconflict. Who owns the NLB/KMS/firewall flips and can we shift?

oliver: I can own the firewall/NLB flips (oliver). One question: do we rotate KMS keys during the window? That would push us past 03:00 (likely to ~03:15).

sophia: Can we split the rollout? Do a non-prod routing cut at 02:00-02:30, smoke, then the primary cut at 03:30-04:00. That avoids the partner maintenance window.

liam: There's a CR open: https://git.company/repo/pull/487 — needs eng-platform + infra approvals. @eng-deploy-bot can you re-run the preflight for the new egress rules?

eng-deploy-bot: Preflight queued for PR #487. Results: 2 warnings — NLB healthcheck timeout. Suggestion: increase healthcheck timeout from 10s to 20s. Full log snippet: ```healthcheck: timeout=10s => recommend 20s
check: path=/health status=200 attempts=3
```

aisha: I can take infra approvals if oliver does firewall flips and I own KMS rotation plan. Also legal needs to sign the data-residency checklist before final cut — pinging @sophia for the doc.

sophia: Residency doc: https://docs.company/residency/ap-southeast-checklist — added note "no cross-region backups until 2024-07-01". Legal review in progress.

maya: Plan proposal: oliver = firewall/NLB, aisha = KMS rotation + infra approvals, sophia = legal/data-residency signoff, eng-deploy-bot = preflight. If partner can't move, shift main cut to 03:30 to avoid overlap. React with :+1: if you agree with shifting.

oliver: :thumbsup: shifting to 03:30 works for me.

liam: I'll update the PR description and post a short note to the partner channel with the revised timing.

maya: Thanks. I'll update the calendar, add the incident-channel pings, and set a reminder to check preflight 2h before the window. Owners noted: oliver, aisha, sophia. I'll follow up in ~2h with a final go/no-go.
